svg.title: From B2B pain signal to sticky recurring MRR
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-micro-saas-wedge-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From B2B pain signal to sticky recurring MRR; subtitle: Five-stage vertical AI micro-SaaS execution loop; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate engineering and GTM sequence, not guaranteed retention.; caption: Anchor the software around a system-of-work bottleneck and proprietary context rather than an exposed single-prompt wrapper.; stages: label: Isolate B2B wedge; value: Step 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Mine technographic churn, G2 1-star complaints, and compliance defects; secure paid pilot LOIs first.; label: Ingest domain context; value: Step 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Normalize public registries or tenant documents behind Postgres Row-Level Security and pgvector.; label: Route & cache tokens; value: Step 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Dispatch 85% routine tasks to small models, 15% synthesis to frontier models, with semantic caching.; label: Deliver <5m value; value: Step 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Ship a pre-loaded diagnostic artifact or workflow copilot output in the user's first session.; label: Expand NRR; value: Step 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Compound revenue via metered workflow credits, team seats, embedded VCC rails, and smart dunning.

circle.title: label: Isolate B2B wedge; value: Step 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Mine technographic churn, G2 1-star complaints, and compliance defects; secure paid pilot LOIs first.

circle.title: label: Ingest domain context; value: Step 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Normalize public registries or tenant documents behind Postgres Row-Level Security and pgvector.

text.title: Normalize public registries or tenant documents behind Postgres Row-Level Security and pgvector.

circle.title: label: Route & cache tokens; value: Step 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Dispatch 85% routine tasks to small models, 15% synthesis to frontier models, with semantic caching.

text.title: Dispatch 85% routine tasks to small models, 15% synthesis to frontier models, with semantic caching.

circle.title: label: Deliver <5m value; value: Step 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Ship a pre-loaded diagnostic artifact or workflow copilot output in the user's first session.

text.title: Ship a pre-loaded diagnostic artifact or workflow copilot output in the user's first session.

circle.title: label: Expand NRR; value: Step 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Compound revenue via metered workflow credits, team seats, embedded VCC rails, and smart dunning.

text.title: Compound revenue via metered workflow credits, team seats, embedded VCC rails, and smart dunning.
